sources.entry: A collection of useful resources for building RESTful HTTP+JSON APIs.

summary.one_liner: A curated, link-based reference list of tools, frameworks, specs, guides and learning resources for building RESTful HTTP+JSON APIs.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome"-style list rather than a software project, so it contains no code of its own. It is organized into sections such as API specification languages, specification tools, API frameworks grouped by language (Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Go, Java, PHP, Elixir and others), API client generators and HTTP clients, documentation generators, mocking and debugging tools, API design guides, API gateways, security, monitoring, testing, developer portals, JSON format standards, learning resources and blogs. Each entry is a name followed by a one-line description. The README states contributions are welcome and categories are open to suggestions.
use_cases: Choosing a web framework for building a REST API in a given language
Finding OpenAPI/Swagger editing, linting and documentation tools
Picking an API gateway or load balancer for routing API traffic
Finding mock servers and API testing or debugging tools
Looking up REST API design guidelines and style guides
Locating learning resources on REST and HTTP API design
notable: Covers a broad range of language-specific REST frameworks, from Ruby and Python to Haskell, Erlang and Dart
Groups API specification, documentation, mocking, testing and gateway tools into separate sections
Includes curated API design style guides from companies and government agencies
Lists both open-source and hosted or desktop API client options
caveats: Entries are links with short descriptions only; many may be outdated, and the README does not state maintenance status for each item
Some tools are paid or hosted services; the README does not flag pricing for most entries
